critical_code_review_comments: INFO: /api/admin/users returns the full user doc minus password_hash. It is stripped correctly but consider whitelisting fields explicitly rather than blacklisting, to prevent accidental leakage of future sensitive fields.
INFO: /api/admin/textbooks does per-row Python aggregation (OK for <=500 books). If the school scales past a few thousand books, switch to a Mongo $lookup aggregation.
INFO: PATCH /api/admin/textbooks/{id}/share uses a query-string bool via FastAPI Query; FastAPI parses 'true'/'false' correctly, but a JSON body would be slightly more REST-idiomatic. Not a bug.
MINOR: server.py is now ~1789 lines. At this size consider splitting admin endpoints into /app/backend/admin_routes.py for maintainability (per 700-line guideline).
